title: Your phone
descriptionFa: قسمت‌های گوشی، کار با گوشی هوشمند، و قفل و حافظه.

words.example: My new phone has a great camera.
This app tells you when the next bus is coming.
Hold the power button for three seconds to turn off the phone.
I dropped my phone, but the phone case protected it.
My battery is low. Can I charge my phone here?
words.tipFa: باتری تموم شده: The battery is dead / My phone is dead.

words.example: I forgot my charger at home.
I bought a local SIM card at the airport.

words.tipFa: برای حافظه‌ی آدم هم هست: I have a bad memory.
برای کارت بانکی هم همینه. کوتاه‌شده‌ی personal identification number.

words.example: My phone is locked and I can't remember the code!
Use your fingerprint to unlock the phone.
Swipe left to see the next photo.
I'll call you tonight after dinner.
words.tipFa: call someone، بدون to: call my mum، نه call to my mum.

words.example: You can download this app for free.
Excuse me, could you take a photo of us, please?
words.tipFa: take a photo، نه make یا do a photo.

words.example: We took a selfie in front of the Azadi Tower.
Don't forget to save the file before you close it.
words.tipFa: save یعنی «پس‌انداز کردن» و «نجات دادن» هم هست.

words.example: Can you delete that photo? I look terrible!
